sloka: स्थलनिम्नानि भूमेश्च समानि विषमाणि च ।युद्धकालश्च विज्ञेयः परस्यान्तरदर्शनम् ।। ६.१०६.१९ ।।
transliteration: sthalanimnāni bhūmeśca samāni viṣamāṇi ca ।yuddhakālaśca vijñeyaḥ parasyāntaradarśanam ।। 6.106.19 ।।

translations.english: "The earths' ups and downs, evenness and ruggedness, difficult locations, the right time and place for war should be known in advance and the inner weakness of the enemy also to be known."
